product.name: BarkBite Durable Chew Toy
product.description: Designed for active dogs, the BarkBite Chew Toy offers a robust combination of nylon fibers and natural rubber that resists shredding and chewing. Its 30‑cm length and 5‑cm width provide a satisfying bite surface, while the bright red and blue color scheme keeps the toy visually engaging. The toy is engineered to withstand the jaws of dogs up to 20 kg, making it suitable for medium‑sized breeds. No electrical components are included, so the product is safe for unsupervised play. The lightweight construction at 0.5 kg allows easy handling for owners and portability for on‑the‑go adventures. The toy’s textured surface encourages healthy chewing habits and helps maintain dental hygiene.
